android.desc:
Social Group Lead Scraper will help you extract lead from Facebook group members. This is Facebook Group Lead Extractor app, Facebook Email Extractor, Facebook Phone Extractor , Facebook Scraper Tool ... AI Data Extraction.

To be able to use Social Group Lead Scraper you need to login to your Facebook account, any Facebook account that you are member of the Facebook group that you want to extract member leads, include email, phone, name...

Some highlight features of Social Group Lead Scraper -  Facebook Group Lead Extractor app, Facebook Email Extractor, Facebook Phone Extractor , Facebook Scraper Tool - app:
- Support email, phone lead extractor for Facebook group members lead - email, phone, name... extractor.
- Support almost unlimited Facebook group members extractor.
- Smart pause between two extractor to reduce calls to Facebook!
- Export data while Social Group Lead Scraper extracting Facebook leads (email, phone, name)
- Support auto resume when app crash or lost internet connection.....

And sure, if you don't know how to use Social Group Lead Scraper  ( Facebook Group Lead Extractor app, Facebook Email Extractor, Facebook phone extractor , Facebook Scraper Tool) app, feel free to ping us to support!
